blocks.text: (It's like the Indonesian in America who finishes dinner at an Italian restaurant, has pasta and steak, then admits not to eat because they don't eat rice.)
Elwin Tobing

Since the beginning, I've judged Gibran Rakabuming inadequate to be vice president. I'm also against the political dynasty, especially when it comes to the influence of state power. This practice enrages meritocracy and inhibits the progress of the nation.
I'm also a hard critic for the development of Jokowi, especially in his second period.

After prioritizing physical infrastructure in the first period, in various texts I emphasized that Indonesia should focus on transformation of human quality. That's the foundation of economic progress. Since the result takes a long time, the transformation must not be delayed. However, Indonesia was treated by lKN and the continued village funds.
My position is clear. In principle and policy, I'm not a team. However, any sentiment, including politics, must not change the standard of proof.

There are many reasons to question Gibran's worth as vice president. As outlined here, high school diploma is not one of them. This policy only reveals the common lack of reason for an accused party than it does for one.

Gibran has retreated and political drama is entering the next round. Underneath all that, fundamental issues are still missing: common sense and understanding of the foreign education system. Both are still our weaknesses. And that could harm the young people of Indonesia. That's my base trying to straighten this tangled thread.
Gibran Education Fact
Here's the history of Gibran's education based on court documents and related educational agencies.
S002: Surakarta Junior State. Finish middle school education before going to Singapore.
_ Following Seconary 3 and 4, the last two years of middle-aged education lane four years to the exam of General Certimate of Education Ordinary Level (GCE O-Level).

2004: GCE O-Level Exam. Graduated five of the six subjects: the Combined Humanities (B4), Math (C6), Science (B4), Arts and Design (B3), as well as Malay Language (B3). Only English (E8) doesn't pass.
According to Singapore Examinations and Assessment Board, the value A1 x6 meets graduation standards, while E8 is below it. The O-Level certificate can be obtained by passing at least one lesson.

February 2005 October 2006 UTS Insearch, Sydney. Following the Diplomas of Business Studies program for six triyesterners, about 20 months. Available documents include evidence of registration, attendance, and academic transcripts, but not a diploma graduation certificate.

2007 2010: MDIS, Singapore On October 1, 2025, the MDIS confirmed that Gibran studied full-time, completed Advanced Diploma, and won a Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Marketing from MDISN University of Bradford, England.
One chronological fact for context. When Gibran went to school in Singapore, Jokowi was still a furniture businessman. When Gibran got his degree in 2010, Jokowi was the mayor of Solo City.
Gibran Education Line Reconset
How do you understand the journey of education?
Based on my experience of teaching thousands of students in the United States, including international students, following their reconstruction course.

With the value of the GCE O-Level, Gibran has a hard time getting on the path of conventional high education in Singapore. To enter Junior College, for example, generally requires a minimum C6 English value and meets the requirement of combined value.
Gibran got E8 in English and C6 in Mathematics. His weakness, especially on both subjects, is not entirely.

However, this problem also reflects the weakness of Indonesian education. Gibran graduated from primary and middle school Indonesia. Over the past two decades, PISA results show that about 75 years ago, 83 percent of Indonesian students in 15 years have not reached minimum competence and reading and mathematics. Almost nothing reaches the highest level of mathematics, compared to 41 percent in Singapore.

The 2025 academic aptitude test is also alarming. The national value of English language is only 25 out of 100, whereas Math is 36. This is the biggest failure of Indonesian education and fundamental problems that should be the nation's attention.

Armed with GCE O-Level certificates, Gibran continues to UTS Insearch, Australia, to prepare for college. Given his English value, preparation in Sydney also includes strengthening English skills while taking business lectures.

With an O-Level certificate, English is better, and the UTS Inspection transcript, he then goes on to MDIS. Some of the previous courses got academic credit recognition, so he could get a degree from MDISN University of Bradford in three years.
This reconstruction shows a continuity of reasonable education, not just a collection of documents from different institutions.
So, where's Gibran High School's diploma?
That question shows a fundamental error: we use Indonesian educational framework to assess academic travel in other state systems.
It's like an Indonesian who finishes dinner at an Italian restaurant, eats pasta and steak, then claims he hasn't eaten because he doesn't eat rice.

Singapore uses GCE O-Level certificates as a qualification of middle education, not a high school diploma like in Indonesia. The difference in the form of documents doesn't mean someone hasn't undertaken a relevant education.

Gibran had gone to a middle school in Singapore, nearly two years of advanced education in Australia, and finally got a degree from the British university. Why are we still fixated on high school diploma, like higher academic achievement doesn't mean anything?
Who is the Officer of Equality of Education?

Interstate education equality must be judged by parties who understand the international education system. It's not enough to compare the age, the name of the diploma, or the number of years of school. The quality of learning is also important.
According to the World Bank, learning-promoted years of schooling Singapore reached 12.8 years, while Indonesia was only 7.8 years old. These indicators reckon long education and learning results.
Based on that ratio, ten years of education in the Singapore system is expected to produce 9.2 years of effective learning. Meanwhile, twelve years of education in Indonesia is only about 7.5.
So, two years of secondary 3 and 4 education in Singapore theoretically produced effective learning equivalent to three high school years in Indonesia.
Determination of education equality requires expertise, not just diploma checking or long school.

This matter isn't just about Gibran. Many Indonesian children traveled a different track of education abroad. Don't let the ignorance of the international education system harm their future. That's why I was driven to explain this.
When the Ijalah Defeats Nalar

When I applied for a job as a business analyst in the United States after my master's degree, and then as a professor after getting a doctor, I was only asked to demonstrate my highest education diploma. Not the entire diploma since elementary school.
In Indonesia, obsession with diploma is so far up the question: does a doctorate even have to prove his junior degree?
The number 7 law 2017 requires that the presidential candidate and vice president be educated in high school or as low-class.
Pay attention to the lowest phrases. The law sets a minimum limit for education, not limiting recognition to higher qualification.
Therefore, the substantial question is: is the Gibran degree of the University of Bradford legal?
MDIS has given written confirmation. If you're still in doubt, verify it to the university's title. Do not treat the higher education that has been confirmed as if it never existed.
When Sentiment Defeats Nalar
Did Gibran become the vice president for having a high school diploma?

If I was to be appointed a professor based on a doctorate, it would be natural if the authenticity of that title were questioned. But what if the only thing in question is a high school diploma, while my doctorate is legal? Isn't it my degree in appointment?

Buying a diploma, getting a degree with just the amount of college, using jockeys to write a thesis or dissertation, to fake a diploma is a serious issue. This kind of practice is not foreign in Indonesia. However, following different foreign education paths is another matter.
The Gibran Polymic taught us a lesson. We can defy the political dynasty, question its worth, even have political antipathy.
However, intellectual honesty must not be sacrificed in order to justify political behavior. Ironically, some of the educated people are caught up in this mistake.

Critical thinking is not just about finding other people's mistakes, it's about testing their own beliefs. As a reminder of Nobel Physician Richard Feynman, the first principle is that you must not fool yourself and you are the earest person to fool.
Public ignorance isn't always the source of the wrong information. The true facts can mislead when released from their context to lead to the wrong conclusion.
But when political sentiment determines which facts are accepted and rejected, the sane lose their place. Ironically, those who think they're preaching the public can fool them.

Elwin Tobing, coach of economics, president of ADATA, Irvine, U.S.. Elwin developed the LIFT-Literacy Movement for Future and NEXUS Program to transform literacy, natural power, and the character of Indonesian students.
